Sensorium,

Yertigo,  as  if  intoxicated.

when  stooping


after  eating.


when  lifting  up  the  eyes.

and  loss  of  sight.

Mead.


Congestion  of  blood  to  the  head,
with  stinging  pulsation  in  the  brain,
especially  when  stooping

Pain,  as  if  the  head  would  burst. . . .

in  the  temples.

ing forwards.

in  the  morning

in  the  warm  room

in  the  open  air

the  face
